# northflank_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a root domain registered with the team, and the subdomains added to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_domain" "root" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "subdomains" {
  value = [for s in data.northflank_domain.root.subdomains : s.full_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Root domain, such as `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) `pending` or `verified`.
- `subdomains` (Attributes List) Subdomains added to the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subdomains))
- `verification_record_name` (String) Name of the TXT record that proves ownership.
- `verification_record_value` (String) Value of the TXT record that proves ownership.

<a id="nestedatt--subdomains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subdomains`

Read-Only:

- `full_name` (String) Full name, such as `api.example.com`.
- `name` (String) The subdomain, as Northflank names it.
